plain_statement: Is there a circuit of AND and OR gates only, each reading at most two wires, every gate counted, with at most 63 gates, true on 26 inputs exactly when both ends of some edge are true? The graph: points 0..12, lines 13..25, point p joined to line 13 + l when p + l is 0, 1, 3 or 9 modulo 13 (the plane of order 3); 52 edges, every degree 4, no cycle of length 4, least vertex cover size 13 (by script). The circuit built from a least cover has 64 gates. Wanted either way: a gate list, verified by evaluation on all 2^26 inputs, or that none exists. No witness is known.
title: Search: a circuit of AND and OR gates with at most 63 gates for the point-line graph of the projective plane of order 3
